_about: The Quest Book's Feats (src/world/feats.py): per region, feats with tiers [goal, reward, (older flag)]. Rewards: tm (one or a list), items {KEY: qty}, money; more for the harder tiers (Jordan, 11-22). The TMs are ones the region gives nowhere else (dev/checks/quest_book_body.py checks).

KANTO.name: Pokedex Pages
KANTO.desc: Own different Kanto Pokemon: catch them, evolve them, trade for them.

KANTO.name: Type Collector
KANTO.desc: Own Kanto Pokemon of as many different types as you can.

KANTO.name: Battle Hardened
KANTO.desc: Win battles against trainers anywhere in Kanto. Rematches count too!

KANTO.name: Walker
KANTO.desc: Walk Kanto's towns, routes and caves step by step.

KANTO.name: Strong Bonds
KANTO.desc: Raise Pokemon to Lv. 50 or higher (party and PC).

KANTO.name: Math Whiz
KANTO.desc: Answer math questions right in a row while in Kanto.

KANTO.name: Angler
KANTO.desc: Hook Pokemon with a fishing rod.

KANTO.name: Treasure Hunter
KANTO.desc: Find wild Pokemon by Headbutting trees or smashing rocks.

KANTO.name: Stone Collector
KANTO.desc: Evolve Pokemon with evolution stones and other items.

KANTO.name: Pokemon Catcher
KANTO.desc: Catch wild Pokemon, any kind, as many as you like.

KANTO.name: Safari Explorer
KANTO.desc: Catch Pokemon in Fuchsia's Safari Zone with Safari Balls.

KANTO.name: Sevii Explorer
KANTO.desc: Explore the Sevii Islands: every island, cave, path and ruin. Some only open to a Champion.

KANTO.name: Tanoby Scholar
KANTO.desc: Catch Unown of every shape. The Tanoby Ruins hide all 28.
